From one parent to another

I opened this school for my own children.

I founded Escola Montessoriana in January 2025 with a simple wish: to offer the very best for the development of my own children, now 2 and 9 years old.

I wanted a place where they would be welcomed with real warmth and affection and, at the same time, get an education that is personal and grounded in real life; where they could choose, try, make mistakes and discover themselves at their own pace. I couldn't find that school ready-made — so we built one: the Montessori method, English lived day by day, and the kind of care only a truly attentive school can give.

And now you can give all of this to your children too, at Escola Montessoriana de Laranjeiras.

Cláudio BerbelFounder · Escola Montessoriana

WHAT MAKES US DIFFERENT · 01

Warm care: affection, calm and bonding — just like home

Low child-to-teacher ratios: just three children per teacher in our under-18-months group. Adults who are truly present, plenty of affection and cuddles, flexible schedules and full respect for each child's own pace.

Here, your child is never just a number.

4 / 17

Concentration is born from choice.

5 / 17
WHAT MAKES US DIFFERENT · 02

Independence: the child in charge of their own learning

Each child chooses, explores and concentrates on what makes sense to them, in a scientifically prepared environment. The teacher observes and guides — never imposes.

That is how independence, confidence and a genuine love of learning are born.

6 / 17

Letters come in through the hands.

7 / 17
From tracing to writing

Reading and writing begin with the body

Sandpaper letters to feel the shape of each sound, a sand tray to practice each stroke, and a movable alphabet to build the first words — long before mastering the pencil.

When interest awakens, writing and reading come naturally — no rushing, no pressure.

8 / 17

Math you can hold in your hands.

9 / 17
The Montessori method

Freedom with structure, from concrete to abstract

In math, quantities become beads and cubes the child stacks, trades and counts: they see and touch what numbers mean before ever working in the abstract.

Materials that invite touch and discovery, mixed-age groups where older children teach and younger ones observe, and a focus on the process — not grades, rewards or punishments.

10 / 17

Every day has stories — and English.

11 / 17
WHAT MAKES US DIFFERENT · 03

Daily English immersion with native-speaking teachers

There is no better time in life to learn a language. Our native teachers speak only English, all day long, and children absorb the language naturally, through play — making the most of the unique window of early childhood, with no pressure and without ever pulling them away from what they love doing.

A third language is also available as an extra activity.
